tagline: Building a smokeless world through transformative nicotine alternatives and reduced-risk products.
hero_kpi_rationale: The New Category segment is the primary driver of future growth, with double-digit acceleration in H2 2025, reflecting the strategic transition toward reduced-risk products.

kpis.name: New Category Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Sales growth in new nicotine products (vaping, modern oral, heated).
kpis.description: Double-digit growth in H2 is driven by Velo Plus in the United States and Vuse Ultra in Europe.
kpis.signal: Clear acceleration in H2, strategic growth engine.

kpis.name: Velo Volume Share (Modern Oral)
kpis.explanation: Velo product's volume market share within the Modern Oral category.
kpis.description: Velo leads in AME and the United States, with rapid market share expansion.
kpis.signal: Clear leadership in the most dynamic category.

kpis.name: Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Evolution of the group's consolidated revenue.
kpis.description: Growth supported by the United States and AME, despite headwinds in APMEA.
kpis.signal: Modest but stable growth despite regulatory challenges.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Cost discipline maintained despite strategic investments.
kpis.signal: High margin despite investments in new products.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual spending on tangible and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Capex held at £650 million in 2025, focused on strategic product launches.
kpis.signal: Stable level, prioritization of profitable markets.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow Conversion
kpis.explanation: Ratio of cash generated to adjusted operating profit.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.819 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $5.238 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last three fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 67.5% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Vuse Revenue Trend
kpis.explanation: Revenue performance of the Vuse brand, impacted by illicit products.
kpis.description: Revenue down 8% in 2025 (vs -13% in H1), with improvement in the United States.

kpis.name: glo Hilo Launch
kpis.explanation: Expansion of the premium glo Hilo product in key markets.
kpis.description: Launches in H2 2025 in Japan, Poland and Italy, with rollouts planned for 2026.

risks.title: Illicit trade and counterfeiting competition
risks.score_rationale: Ranked top business execution risk (pages 4-5), language is strong: 'significant and growing threat', 'substantial fines', 'seizure payments'. Upward trend linked to inflation and regulatory restrictions (plain packaging) favoring illicit players. Core category for a global tobacco group.

risks.title: Regulatory risk on New Categories (vaping, oral)
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements and in the 'New Categories supply chain' risk (pages 5-6); strong language: 'denial of PMTA', 'ban on menthol in California', 'regulatory changes leading to product recalls'. Upward trend with increasing geographic restrictions. High criticality as New Categories are BAT's strategic growth engine.

risks.title: Supply chain vulnerability in New Categories
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated risk on pages 5-6 with explicit language: 'dependency on single suppliers', 'multi-tiered and complex environment', 'product recalls experienced in the past'. Trend stable to upward due to trade wars and tariffs. High weight as BAT's growth depends on successful execution of its New Categories strategy.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and information systems breaches
risks.score_rationale: Detailed risk on pages 5-6 with explicit mention of AI as a new attack vector ('AI-powered tools and nation-state capabilities'). Strong language: 'continuously under attack', 'phishing, malware, unauthorized access'. Upward trend with intensifying external threat landscape. Cross-cutting risk affecting manufacturing, distribution, R&D and financial reporting.

risks.title: Geopolitical tensions disrupting multi-market operations
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed risk on pages 4-5 with concrete examples ('attacks on shipping routes in the Red Sea', nationalizations, embargoes). Moderately strong language: 'unpredictable and outside of its control'. Upward trend given global context. Amplified by concentration of outsourced services in certain regions.

risks.title: Exposure to agricultural commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned toward the end of the excerpt with multiple factors (inflation, tariffs, natural disasters). Moderate language but structural risk for a company whose core business remains tobacco. Trend stable but potentially upward due to climate change impacts on tobacco harvests. Moderate weight as BAT has a diversified supply base.

risks.title: Exposure to product-related litigation and external investigations
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking statements as a key factor ('adverse litigation and external investigations') and in the illicit trade risk ('misplaced claims against BAT'). Strong language: 'substantial fines', 'civil and criminal liability'. Trend stable but persistent and costly risk for the tobacco industry. High weight given sector history.

risks.title: Inability to execute the transformation strategy toward New Categories
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements ('inability to develop, commercialise and deliver the Group's New Categories strategy') and in the supply chain risk. Strong language: 'fail to deliver on its strategic growth plans', 'loss of investor confidence'. Trend stable as structural execution risk tied to business model transformation. Very high weight as this is BAT's strategic pivot.
